artworks.title: Road at Hérisson
artworks.medium: brush with black and gray inks over charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with sparse trees and rolling terrain viewed from a slightly elevated point. The horizon is low in the composition, with a light sky in the background. Slim trees with slender trunks are irregularly dispersed across the land. The brushstrokes are impressionistic, creating texture on the ground and leaves. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, with shades of gray creating a subdued atmosphere. The texture and style suggest an overcast day with a play of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Self Portrait of Willem Drost
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person from the waist up. The individual is slightly angled, facing the viewer with their head turned to the left. They have distinct facial features with a contemplative expression and styled hair falling down the side of their face. The person is dressed in a loose, long-sleeved, collared garment. In their hand, they hold drawing instruments and a sheet of paper featuring sketch-like drawings of geometrical shapes. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Landscape with Trees and Craggy Rocks
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape drawing from a slight elevation. The horizon is positioned towards the upper section with distant mountains in the background. The composition mainly features trees and rocky formations, drawn in a linear style using flowing pen strokes. There are large trees and rocks detailed with cross-hatching in the foreground, with smaller trees scattered across open fields in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic with natural tones and dark brown ink.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from an elevated perspective, with a sweeping scene that stretches into the distance. The horizon is placed in the middle of the image, with undulating hills and distant mountains barely visible. The painting features broad, fluid brushstrokes with a wash effect in shades of brown, creating a softened, sketch-like quality. Dark silhouettes of trees with thick foliage dominate the foreground, while rolling fields or plains extend into the background. The sky is filled with large, fluffy clouds expressed through swirling, loose lines, harmonizing with the earthly tones below.

artworks.title: Study of Heads [recto]
artworks.medium: black and red chalks heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows various sketch-like depictions of faces and figures. There are four main sketches: two male faces in partial profile at the top and bottom, a smaller red-toned figure above them, and another male face at the bottom looking down with closed eyes. The top left male face appears open-mouthed with flowing hair and a beard, while the top right face has a furrowed brow and a prominent nose. The smaller red-toned figure in the center is depicted with a raised arm. The drawings are set against a blue background and employ various line techniques for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Two Reclining Figures [verso]
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of two figures with only the upper halves of their bodies visible. The figure on the left is upright with a slight tilt, looking down towards the other figure who is leaning back with their head elevated and gazing upwards. The facial features of the left figure are softly sketched with minimal detail, while the right figure's face is shaded with indistinct features. The hair of both figures is flowing, with the left figure having somewhat untamed hair and the right figure's hair cascading around their head. The clothing is suggested with soft, drapery-like lines. The background is textured with swirling shades, creating an abstract and ethereal ambiance with no defined objects.

artworks.title: Turkish Stage Design
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a central architectural structure on the horizon. Surrounding the building are palm trees, a garden setting, and another structure with blue awnings. Rolling hills and more palm trees are also visible. The painting features detailed brushstrokes and a color palette of earthy tones with hints of blue and warm hues.

artworks.title: An Allegorical Female Figure
artworks.medium: black and red chalks, heightened with white, on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure with wings. The figure is floating or flying, with arms extended upwards holding objects. The figure is dressed in flowing robes. The wings have a feathered texture. The drawing uses soft lines and shading to create depth in the figure, who has a serene or determined expression.

artworks.title: Portal of the Hôtel d'Uzès, rue Montmartre, Paris
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts an elaborately decorated archway, resembling a triumphal arch. The horizon is shown through the line of the arch's base and adjacent walls. Detailed brushstrokes display intricate carvings and reliefs on the columns and frieze. The color palette consists of sepia tones and browns. People in historical attire are gathered, conversing or walking. In the distance, an inner passageway and other structures can be seen. The composition's muted colors and linear perspective highlight the architecture and period setting.

artworks.title: A Trophy of Arms
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of military armor and weaponry, including a helmet, shield, spears, and flags. The color palette is grayscale with blacks, whites, and various shades of gray. In the foreground, there is a detailed armor set. Spears and flags rise behind the helmet, and a large shield with intricate designs is in the lower right. A decorative drapery is in the center, with additional ornamental details like floral and animal motifs throughout.

artworks.title: A Judge and Two Gentlemen Lawyers
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows three people in various poses. On the left, a person is depicted from the back, dressed in a flowing garment with voluminous sleeves and wearing a cap on their head. The middle figure is in a profile view, facing right, standing bent, and wearing a hat with a wide brim and a long coat or cloak. The person on the right is also in a profile view, facing left, with one arm extended forwards. They wear a similar broad-brimmed hat and voluminous clothing, detailed with fabric folds and a belt. The background is plain, focusing on the figures and their clothing, capturing a moment of interaction or movement.

artworks.title: Piazza by Moonlight
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache, on blue prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a high horizon, showing a sky with clouds and hills. The artwork features detailed line work, shading, brushstrokes for depth and texture, and a monochromatic color palette. Figures in robes and hats are near a fountain, with a pedestal, vegetation, and a structure in the distance.

artworks.title: Battle of the Gods and Giants from Mount Olympus and Mount Othrys
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: There is a drawing depicting multiple muscular figures reaching upward amidst clouds. The figures are sketched with fluid lines and appear to be engaged in a dynamic interaction. They are predominantly nude and the artist paid attention to anatomical detail and light and shadow. The composition is dense, with the figures entwined. Swirling clouds surround them, suggesting a celestial or mythological setting. The drawing is in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Study of a Young Boy
artworks.medium: red chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a side-reclining person sketched in nearly full-body view. The figure leans back slightly, supported by their left arm, with the head turned to the side. Facial features include a pronounced nose and subtle expression. Short, curly or wavy hair is depicted. The person is unclothed, and the muscles are subtly defined in the drawing. The sketch is on light brown textured paper with a decorative border.

artworks.title: A Scene from the Life of Trajan
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a historical scene set in a Roman military encampment. The drawing shows various figures engaged in different activities. In the foreground, two figures dressed in Roman armor and capes stand beside a decorated tent. One figure raises a piece of cloth while the other seems to be conversing. Surrounding them are individuals in various poses. In the middle ground, more figures are visible, some on horseback and others carrying equipment. The background shows a busy encampment with tents and soldiers, creating depth in the scene. The drawing is in a monochromatic sepia tone.

artworks.title: Pastoral Scene
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with two figures near a well. The drawing depicts a well with a woman seated to the left, her body facing towards a man standing to the right. The woman appears to be holding something close to her chest. The man is barefoot, leaning on the well with one hand, and holding a staff in the other. Their garments have intricate folds and drapery emphasizing the texture and movement. Behind them is a stone wall adorned with plants, and towering trees fill the background. The use of lines and shading creates a sense of depth and atmosphere.

artworks.title: Design for a State Bedroom
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with colored washes on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate theatrical stage design. The interior scene features richly decorated walls with classical architectural elements such as columns, pilasters, and sculptural figures. Luxurious drapes and swags hang along the upper part of the design. In the center is a raised stage area with steps leading up to it, and a balcony-like structure with intricate balustrades and ornamentation. Floral motifs and relief sculptures add to the decorative elements, suggesting a Baroque or Rococo style.

artworks.title: Figure Studies
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on blue wove paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several muscular figures and scenes sketched for a larger composition. The drawing features figures on a teal-tinted background, showcasing the human form in active configurations. On the left side, there is a rectangular panel containing figures intertwined with swirling lines. To the right, separate figure studies show dynamic poses, emphasizing anatomical structure and movement. The sketch lines are fluid and expressive, suggesting preliminary studies.

artworks.title: Male Nude with a Lamp (Diogenes)
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art

artworks.title: A Kneeling Woman with an Incense Burner and a Page Holding a Crown and Scepter
artworks.artist: Anton Kern, after Giovanni Battista Pittoni the younger
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals kneeling. The person on the left is leaning forward, their head slightly lowered and turned to the right. They wear a long robe with detailed hem and their arms are wrapped around it. The person on the right has curly hair and is holding a platter with a crown and keys hanging from it. Both wear draped garments. The background is simple, focusing on the figures.

artworks.title: Resting Horse
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse. The drawing depicts a horse in a seated position, with its body facing away from the viewer while its head is turned to the side, looking toward the viewer. The horse's mane is depicted with wavy lines, giving it a textured appearance. The body of the horse is outlined with shading to accentuate the muscular structures and fur texture. The drawing is likely created using pencil or charcoal. The background is minimal, with some light shading.

artworks.title: Ladies and Gentlemen Enjoying a Dutch Garden
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a symmetrical composition with a pathway bordered by rows of tall, neatly trimmed trees leading to a building in the distance. The horizon is positioned midway within the image, where the trees meet the house. The structure has a classic design with a doorway and large windows. The trees and foliage are detailed and textured, while the sky is soft and diffused. The color palette includes muted tones of gray and sepia. There are figures walking along the paths in fashionable attire, and the path extends straight towards the central house, creating depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash over black chalk, squared in black chalk, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of abstract figures in a grand setting. The artwork shows various figures positioned around a central figure on a raised platform or steps, leading the eye upwards towards a cluster of swirling clouds and abstract figures. The figures are sketched with fluid lines and the background suggests an architectural setting with arches and pillars. Ink wash is used to add depth and texture to the figures and the setting, giving the drawing a sense of movement and drama.

artworks.title: Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a classical setting. The drawing features several sketchily-rendered figures, appearing to be engaged in conversation or interactions in an architectural setting that includes columns and possibly arches. The lines are loose and the forms are not fully detailed, indicating that this might be a preliminary sketch or study rather than a finished work. The composition is dynamic, with figures strategically placed across the layered backdrop that suggests depth and perspective. The use of brown ink on the paper gives it a historical feel.
